perfil: Shia's grandmother is Marlene, a legendary seafaring Trekker. She is also close to Karin.

habilidades.b: Commands Snow Rabbit and Night Rabbit to attack the target in turn to deal DMG.

tpl.s: Commands drones to attack the target in turn. Strike 1: Snow Rabbit fires bullets in a sweeping motion, dealing ⟦0⟧ of ATK as Lux Auto Attack DMG. Strike 2: Night Rabbit fires missiles, dealing ⟦1⟧ of ATK as Lux Auto Attack DMG. Strike 3: Snow Rabbit fires bullets in a sweeping motion, dealing ⟦2⟧ of ATK as Lux Auto Attack DMG. Strike 4: Night Rabbit fires missiles, dealing ⟦3⟧ of ATK as Lux Auto Attack DMG.

habilidades.b: Summons several drones to attack the target repeatedly, dealing DMG. The Main Skill can trigger ⟨Lux Mark⟩ and summon a Thunderbolt.

tpl.s: Calls for support. Commands 2 Snow Rabbits and 1 Night Rabbit to circle and attack the target for 10s. Snow Rabbits fire bullets in a sweeping motion, dealing ⟦0⟧ of ATK as Lux Skill DMG. Night Rabbit fires missiles, dealing ⟦1⟧ of ATK as Lux Skill DMG, and then explodes, dealing ⟦2⟧ of ATK as AoE Lux Skill DMG. Whirling Waves (Main Skill) can trigger ⟨Lux Mark⟩ and summon a Thunderbolt, dealing ⟪0⟫ of ATK as Lux Mark DMG.

builds.d: A build that enhances the Snow Rabbit drone, ideal for fighting a single target.
A build that enhances the Night Rabbit drone, ideal for fighting multiple targets.

l.b: When dealing Auto Attack DMG, Snow Rabbit inflicts Electro Music that deals additional DMG upon reaching the max stack limit.
l.s: When Snow Rabbit deals Auto Attack DMG, it inflicts Electro Music, stacking up to ⟦0⟧ times. Upon reaching the max stack limit, Electro Music's stacks are removed, dealing ⟦1⟧ of ATK as Lux Skill DMG.

l.b: The Main Skill summons a Snow Rabbit that inflicts Electro Music when dealing Skill DMG, dealing additional DMG upon reaching the max stack limit.
l.s: Whirling Waves (Main Skill) summons a Snow Rabbit, dealing ⟦0⟧ of ATK as Lux Skill DMG upon entering combat. Every time Snow Rabbit deals Skill DMG, it inflicts Electro Music, stacking up to ⟦1⟧ times. Upon reaching the max stack limit, Electro Music's stacks are removed, dealing ⟦2⟧ of ATK as Lux Skill DMG.

l.b: The Main Skill summons more Snow Rabbits. While the Main Skill is active, increases all Snow Rabbits' Lux DMG.
l.s: Whirling Waves (Main Skill) summons 1 additional Snow Rabbit. While the Main Skill is active, increases all Snow Rabbits' Lux DMG by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: Increases Snow Rabbit's Auto Attack DMG. Bullets from Auto Attacks can pierce through targets.
l.s: Increases Snow Rabbit's Auto Attack DMG by ⟦0⟧. Bullets from Auto Attacks can pierce through targets.

l.b: When a Snow Rabbit triggers ⟨Lux Mark⟩, increases all the Snow Rabbits' ATK.
l.s: When a Snow Rabbit triggers ⟨Lux Mark⟩, increases all the Snow Rabbits' ATK by ⟦0⟧ for 5s, stacking up to 6 times.

l.b: Night Rabbit fires tracking bullets at nearby targets during Auto Attacks. When the tracking bullets deal DMG, Night Rabbit gains Moongaze, increasing its DMG.
l.s: During Auto Attacks, Night Rabbit locks up to ⟦0⟧ targets and fires a tracking bullet at each, each dealing ⟦1⟧ of ATK as AoE Lux DMG. When the tracking bullets deal DMG, Night Rabbit Gains 1 stack of Moongaze. Each stack of Moongaze increases Night Rabbit's Lux DMG by ⟦2⟧ for ⟦3⟧s, stacking up to ⟦4⟧ times.

l.b: Night Rabbit summoned by the Main Skill fires tracking bullets at nearby targets when attacking. When the tracking bullets deal DMG, Night Rabbit gains Moongaze, increasing its DMG.
l.s: Night Rabbit summoned by the Main Skill locks up to ⟦0⟧ targets and fires a tracking bullet at each, each dealing ⟦1⟧ of ATK as AoE Lux DMG. When the tracking bullets deal DMG, Night Rabbit Gains 1 stack of Moongaze. Each stack of Moongaze increases Night Rabbit's Lux DMG by ⟦2⟧ for ⟦3⟧s, stacking up to ⟦4⟧ times.

l.b: Night Rabbit's missile splits after hitting a target, dealing DMG to nearby targets.
l.s: Night Rabbit's missile splits after hitting a target, dealing DMG to up to 3 nearby targets, dealing ⟦0⟧ as Lux Skill DMG to each. This effect can only be triggered once per target per second.

l.b: Based on the number of targets hit by Night Rabbit's Auto Attack, increases the DMG of its next Auto Attack.
l.s: During Auto Attacks, every time Night Rabbit deals DMG to a different target, increases the Auto Attack DMG of its next Auto Attack by ⟦0⟧, stacking up to 5 times.

l.b: Reduces the Attack Interval of Night Rabbits summoned by the Main Skill and increases Skill DMG.
l.s: Reduces the Attack Interval of Night Rabbits summoned by Whirling Waves (Main Skill) by 40%, and increases Skill DMG by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: While Whirling Waves (Main Skill) is active, increases Shia's Movement SPD. When there are no nearby targets, increases Shia's Lux DMG.
l.s: While Whirling Waves (Main Skill) is active, increases Shia's Movement SPD by 30%. When there are no nearby targets, increases Shia's Lux DMG by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: Increases Shia's Lux DMG to a target with less than 50% HP.
l.s: Increases Shia's Lux DMG to a target with less than 50% HP by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: Shia can dodge one more time. When Shia triggers ⟨Lux Mark⟩, increases her ATK.
l.s: Shia can dodge one more time. When Shia triggers ⟨Lux Mark⟩, increases her ATK by ⟦0⟧ for 8s, stacking up to 2 times.

l.b: Every time the Ultimate lands a Crit Hit, increases Shia's ATK.
l.s: Every time Divine Deluge (Ultimate) lands a Crit Hit, increases Shia's ATK by ⟦0⟧ for 10s, stacking up to 20 times.

l.b: When Shia casts the Ultimate, if other squadmates' Ultimates are all on cooldown, increases this cast's Ultimate DMG.
l.s: When Shia casts Divine Deluge (Ultimate), if other squadmates' Ultimates are all on cooldown, increases this Ultimate's Ultimate DMG by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: Increases Shia's Ultimate Lux DMG and reduces the Ultimate's Attack Interval.
l.s: Reduces the interval between bombs of Divine Deluge (Ultimate) by 30% and increases its Lux DMG by ⟦0⟧.

builds.d: A support build that summons multiple drones after the skill ends to deal continuous DMG.
A support build that deals burst DMG by triggering more surfing attacks when the skill is active.

l.b: After casting the Support Skill, summons Snow Rabbits that follow the main Trekker and attack targets.
l.s: When Surfing Rondo (Support Skill) ends, summons ⟦0⟧ Snow Rabbits that follow the main Trekker and fire bullets to attack targets, dealing ⟦1⟧ as Lux Skill DMG for ⟦2⟧s.

l.b: After casting the Support Skill, summons Night Rabbits that attack targets.
l.s: When Surfing Rondo (Support Skill) ends, summons ⟦0⟧ Night Rabbits that fire missiles to attack targets, dealing ⟦1⟧ as Lux Skill DMG for ⟦2⟧s.

l.b: Increases the drones' DMG based on the number of drones on the battlefield.
l.s: For each drone on the battlefield, increases the drones' Lux DMG by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: When Snow Rabbit deals DMG, increases Skill DMG.
l.s: Every time Snow Rabbit deals DMG, increases Shia's Skill DMG by ⟦0⟧, stacking up to 24 times. When casting Surfing Rondo (Support Skill), resets this effect.

l.b: When Shia triggers ⟨Lux Mark⟩, increases Night Rabbit's Skill DMG.
l.s: When Shia triggers ⟨Lux Mark⟩, increases Skill DMG of Night Rabbit by ⟦0⟧ for 5s.

l.b: Increases the number of times Shia can surf and the DMG dealt by each ride.
l.s: Increases the number of times Shia can surf by ⟦0⟧ and the Skill DMG dealt by each ride by ⟦1⟧.

l.b: Shia leaves behind a charged area as she surfs, dealing DMG over time.
l.s: Shia leaves behind a charged area as she surfs, dealing ⟦0⟧ AoE Lux Skill DMG every ⟦1⟧s, lasting for ⟦2⟧s.

l.b: When Shia deals DMG with surfing, stuns the target. Increases Skill DMG of her rides.
l.s: When Shia deals DMG with surfing, stuns the target for 3s. Increases Skill DMG of her rides by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: While the Support Skill is active, increases Shia's ATK over time.
l.s: While Surfing Rondo (Support Skill) is active, increases Shia's ATK by ⟦0⟧ per second, stacking up to 12 times.

l.b: When Shia deals DMG with surfing, increases the surfing DMG taken by the target.
l.s: When Shia deals DMG with surfing, increases the surfing Skill DMG taken by the target by ⟦0⟧ for 30s, stacking up to 5 times.

l.b: Increases Lux Trekkers' Crit DMG.
l.s: Increases Lux Trekkers' Crit DMG by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: Every time Shia kills a target, increases her ATK.
l.s: Every time Shia kills a target, increases her ATK by ⟦0⟧ for 15s, stacking up to 6 times.

l.b: Every time Shia triggers ⟨Lux Mark⟩, increases her ATK.
l.s: Every time Shia triggers ⟨Lux Mark⟩, increases her ATK by ⟦0⟧ for 15s, stacking up to 6 times.

l.b: Every time the Ultimate lands a Crit Hit, increases Shia's ATK.
l.s: Every time Divine Deluge (Ultimate) lands a Crit Hit, increases Shia's ATK by ⟦0⟧ for 10s, stacking up to 20 times.

l.b: When Shia casts the Ultimate, if other squadmates' Ultimates are all on cooldown, increases this cast's Ultimate DMG.
l.s: When Shia casts Divine Deluge (Ultimate), if other squadmates' Ultimates are all on cooldown, increases this Ultimate's Ultimate DMG by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: Increases Shia's Ultimate Lux DMG and reduces the Ultimate's Attack Interval.
l.s: Reduces the interval between bombs of Divine Deluge (Ultimate) by 30% and increases its Lux DMG by ⟦0⟧.
